item.title: Applying the Prism Effect to Local Development Policies: A New Way Forward?
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how the prism effect can be applied to local development policies, exploring new approaches to economic and community development at the local level.

item.title: From inventory to insight: Reimagining reviews for JBVI
item.content:encoded:
This special call invites review papers for the Journal of Business Venturing Insights that move beyond traditional literature summaries to offer fresh analytical perspectives. The journal seeks papers that reimagine how researchers approach synthesis and interpretation of entrepreneurship scholarship, transforming accumulated knowledge into actionable insights for the field.

Appel publié par Journal of Business Venturing Insights. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Review papers that synthesize existing knowledge on entrepreneurship and business venturing topics
  • Papers that provide new theoretical frameworks or perspectives on established research areas
  • Systematic analysis and critical assessment of entrepreneurship literature
  • Integration of diverse research streams in business venturing and related fields
  • Papers addressing gaps or contradictions in existing entrepreneurship research
